title: Somnium Engine P-002 — L2 verifier gate (depth, divergence, chain experiments)
description: Independent L2 verifier review of P-002 (branch depth, commits 351b228 + remediation 0e009d2, on merged baseline d5a35f0). First gate returned REJECT on a single blocking documentation defect; re-verification after remediation returned APPROVE.

gate_history.blocking_defect: src/experiment/runner.ts:13-14 docstring asserted divergence 'accumulates along the chain and grows monotonically' — the exact premise P-002 refutes. All other checks (1-9) PASS.

gate_history.note: Remediation scoped to one file (+6/-2), docstring-only. Repo-wide claim search confirms the refuted premise survives nowhere: 7 hits for monotonic/accumulat/grow are either explicit negations of the premise or refer to unrelated accurate accumulation (universe genealogy, propagation pre-mark sets).

checks.name: Change scoping
checks.evidence: 9 files cumulative, all under src/tests/docs; zero Kronos Engine paths; remediation commit touches only runner.ts docstring

checks.name: Formula agreement code/types/doc
checks.evidence: depth.ts:193-198 == types.ts:43-44 == report §8.1:187-192; changedStateCount value-aware with absent-sentinel (depth.ts:163-177); sorted iteration, no Math.random/Date.now

checks.name: Runner semantics unconflated, no statistical layer
checks.evidence: runner.ts:88 worldDiff(parentWorld, world) vs runner.ts:87 computeDepth(canon, baseline, ...); no seed/replicates/ci95/cohensD; runId/setId timestamp-free

checks.name: Acceptance test genuinely corrected
checks.evidence: depth-acceptance.test.ts:167-184 asserts scores[2] < scores[1] and scores[3] > scores[2]; no skip/todo/only; depth-N inheritance via hash equality retained at :154-156

checks.name: Independent numeric reproduction
checks.evidence: CLI divergence 0/26/25/26, worldHashes a3ee76c4/5449ff05/2f586329/819c9e05 stable across invocations

checks.name: Design doc accuracy, no overclaiming
checks.evidence: §8.1 matches code component-for-component; records the fact-churn defect and the multi-fact-collapse v1 limitation

verifier_finding_on_scope_deviation: The remediation lane also edited src/experiment/runner.test.ts, outside its stated file list. Verifier judged this legitimate: the file is new in the same commit (nothing pre-existing was loosened), and the replacement assertion is strictly stronger than the false monotonicity assertion it removed, pinning direction in both directions and adding a parent-relative diff-hash check.
